text:
deploy-bot: Rolling out service/embedder v2.3.0 -> prod (gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100%). change-window: 03/20 02:00-04:00 UTC. watch slo dashboards, esp. p95-latency and 5xx-rate. https://dash.redwood.internal/d/embedder

marta (SRE): Copy. I'll keep an eye on the p95 and error budget panel. If 5xx-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m, call rollback.

kevin (eng-release): Noted. Release notes pushed to the repo: https://git.redwood/release-notes/embedder/v2.3.0. Main changes: KV-cache refactor + aten kernel switch.

alice (runtime): Heads up — this build enables kvcache sticky mode by default. Could increase memory pressure on smaller pods. Monitoring mem-eviction alerts as well.

sre-bot: Alert subscription added: eng-releases#embedder-slo. Triggers: p95-latency > 180ms (3m), 5xx-rate > 0.5% (3m), pod OOM count > 2 (5m).

josh (product): Is there a fallback model variant if we need to degrade?

kevin (eng-release): Yes — routing policy includes fallback to embedder-v2.2.9 (quantized) in the same region. We can pin all traffic to v2.2.9 if needed.

marta (SRE): Seeing a small bump at 02:04 UTC. p95 -> 195ms, 5xx-rate 0.12%. keeping an eye.

marta (SRE): 02:07 UTC: 5xx-rate jump to 0.8% across eu-west-1 for the last 4m. Error traces show downstream client timeouts to kv-store.

alice (runtime): I'm checking infra overlays — a couple of KV nodes had transient GC pauses around 02:05. SRE, want me to trigger routing to fallback variant for eu-west-1 only?

marta (SRE): Yes. Kevin, please pin eu-west-1 -> v2.2.9 at 02:09 UTC. If overall 5xx stays >0.7% after 2m, we'll roll back the whole release.

kevin (eng-release): Running traffic pin command now:
```
rbctl route pin --service embedder --region eu-west-1 --target v2.2.9 --until 02:30
```

deploy-bot: Route pin executed by kevin at 2167890550. Status: success. Traffic split updated: eu-west-1 -> v2.2.9 (100%), other regions still on gradual roll.

marta (SRE): Post-pin check: eu-west-1 5xx-rate dropped to 0.09% within 90s. Global p95 trending down. Looks like fallback helped.

alice (runtime): KV team fixed the GC config on the affected nodes and restarted the pods at 02:15. recommend reverting pin after we confirm stability for 10m.

kevin (eng-release): Agreed. I'll unpin eu-west-1 at 02:26 if metrics hold.

josh (product): Great — please note this incident in the release notes. Small customer-facing blurb + root cause (KV GC) and the fallback step.

marta (SRE): Will file a short post-deploy note. For now: status = degraded -> mitigated. No global rollback.

kevin (eng-release): Unpin executed at 2167890766, eu-west-1 traffic resumed gradual rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary monitor summary: p95 peak 210ms (02:04-02:08), 5xx peak 0.8% (02:05-02:09), incident mitigated via regional pin + kv fix. No rollback. Logging event: rb:event:deploy:2167890123:status:mitigated

marta (SRE): Postmortem action items: (1) add KV GC preflight checks to deploy healthcheck, (2) add automated regional pin runbook, (3) update SLO alert to include per-region trending.

kevin (eng-release): I'll create the PR for the runbook and update the release notes after the postmortem. :thumbsup:

josh (product): Thanks all. Leaving this thread open for any late observations.

marta (SRE): closing eyes on long-tail errors for next hour. ping if anything else appears. :eyes:
